subject: App Crash Report
body: The app crashes when I tap Settings on my iPhone 14 running iOS 17.5. Steps: open app -> sign in -> tap settings.

subject: Login Issue
body: Unable to login after the update. My device is Samsung Galaxy S23 with Android 14. Please fix soon.

subject: Feature Request: Dark Mode
body: Would love to see a dark mode option in the app for evening use. It would make reading much easier.

subject: Data Loss Problem
body: Data sync is failing and some tasks disappeared after I refreshed the app. Please investigate.

subject: Suggestion for Improvement
body: Missing functionality for offline notes would be very helpful for travel.

subject: Poor Customer Service
body: The app is slow and the support experience has been poor. I am disappointed.
